name: aishield-mcp
description: AIShield security scanner as an MCP server: scan MCP tools and AI agents for poisoning, injection, leakage, and supply-chain risk (OWASP MCP Top 10 + Agentic AI Top 10).

tools.name: security_scan
tools.description: Scan an MCP server or agent description for 141 risk categories.

tools.name: agentic_audit
tools.description: Audit an agent against OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (ASI01-ASI10).

tools.name: trust_score
tools.description: Look up an agent's AIShield Trust Score and certification level from the registry.
